source.original_question:
As shown in the figure, and the area of the shaded part in the figure is ()
Choices:
A:πcm²
B:\frac{2}{3}πcm²
C:\frac{1}{2}cm²
D:\frac{2}{3}cm²

adaptations.reason: The source stem is incomplete. Named the quarter-circle and semicircle boundaries visible in the source so the two shaded crescents are unambiguous; numeric length remains in the diagram.

independent_solution.method: Each semicircle has radius 1/2 and area π/8. Their overlap comprises two 90° sectors minus two right triangles: π/8-1/4. The two nonoverlapping crescent areas total π/4-2(π/8-1/4)=1/2.
